feasibility.schema: Existing airport_daily_composition payload has airline and airline-registration-country aggregates plus per-building gate sides and destination airports. Monthly daily means can reuse stored complete profiles after verifying coverage and definitions.
feasibility.september: 28 complete public day profiles plus retained raw records for September 1 (521 rows) and September 2 (548 rows), independently verified by the parent. A collected-departure monthly comparison is feasible after same-definition reclassification/deduplication and coverage checks; it is not evidence of completely confirmed actual operations.
feasibility.october: October 1 through 9 complete; October 10 in progress and excluded.
feasibility.definitions: Reclassify retained raw departures for both months with the same gate table; this can address mixed side versions. Preserve T1 main-building side counts vs T1 total including concourse. No reclassification was implemented or dispatched.
feasibility.destinations: Public day endpoint exposes destination region groups, not full destination-country or airline coverage. Registration country is not destination country or passenger nationality. Stored aggregate coverage not separately certified.
feasibility.retention: Inventory has no pruning rule/retention limit for airport_daily_composition. Rebuild window 0..28 days and public read window 63 days are not retention guarantees.
feasibility.zero: Collector skips empty raw days, so absence cannot certify a genuine complete zero day. Never fill missing days with zero.
feasibility.calculation: Daily mean = sum of comparable complete-day flight counts / included complete dates. Rate = (current mean / previous mean - 1)*100 when previous mean>0. Share changes are percentage points with an explicit denominator. Do not average unlike side versions or infer passengers from flights.
feasibility.execution: Read-only public response and repository inspection only; no new monthly UI, provider requests, database diagnostic or writes.
feasibility.rawRetention: Repository inventory shows no airport_flights deletion policy. A 31-day normal read window, 30-day change history, 28-day profile rebuild and 63-day public profile window are different mechanisms, not raw-data expiry guarantees.

parentIndependentPublicInspection.source: Delegating parent read-only public flight responses; not queried again by this worker.
parentIndependentPublicInspection.statusBoundary: Mostly scheduled, some unknown; this proves retained collected departure records, not completed actual-operation coverage.
